surfaces.title: Skills
surfaces.reason: Holds 'Change Payment Currency (Site Properties)' and 'Site Settings Dashboard Navigation'. The currency one is a REAL uncovered need: a source store declares its own currency (WooCommerce: woocommerce_currency in the general settings group) and nothing in this pipeline reads or applies it, so a migrated site can price in a currency the merchant never chose. No entity authored yet; the source-side read is itself not part of the default discovery sweep.
surfaces.tracking: site/business-contact covers the address half of this group; the store's declared CURRENCY is captured by rp-source-wordpress/scripts/capture-store-settings.js and reported at the setup gate, but nothing WRITES it — Change Payment Currency has no entity yet. Awaiting a decision on whether a migration should set a site's currency at all.
